This is the mechanism by which a great deal of NSFW research data has been built, and it is precisely what your own protocol forbids: 'Do not scrape third-party websites or extract embedded media without authorization.' The repository is explicitly marked historical and no longer maintained, so a large fraction of URLs are dead, and the remainder resolve to hosts whose robots.txt and terms forbid automated collection.
